fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: maxSupporters
docs: Maximum number of validators that may support a single proposal. Bounds
the per-transaction cost of re-tallying the `supporters` list so a
proposal can always be processed within Solana's heap/compute limits.
Must be in `1..=MAX_SUPPORTERS_LIMIT`.

fields.name: newProposalsAllowed
docs: Whether new proposals are allowed to be created. This can be use to
temporarily halt new proposals while a governance upgrade is in progress.

fields.name: author
docs: The public key of the validator who created this proposal

fields.name: forVotesLamports
docs: Total lamports voted in favor of this proposal

fields.name: againstVotesLamports
docs: Total lamports voted against this proposal

fields.name: abstainVotesLamports
docs: Total lamports that abstained from voting on this proposal

fields.name: snapshotSlot
docs: Slot number when the validator stake snapshot was taken

fields.name: numSupporters
docs: Number of supporter entries stored in the account data at the fixed
offset [`Proposal::SUPPORTERS_OFFSET`].
The supporter vote-account pubkeys are intentionally NOT a field of
this struct: they live past the struct's Borsh capacity boundary
(`discriminator + INIT_SPACE`), so Anchor only (de)serializes this
4-byte count. The entries are read zero-copy via
[`Proposal::supporters`] and written by [`Proposal::append_supporter`].

fields.name: delegateSigner
docs: The accepted vote delegate that signed the current state of this vote,
or `None` when `validator` signed it itself. Always `None` on votes
recorded before vote delegation existed.

fields.name: delegate
docs: Key authorized to act for `subject` once `delegation_accepted` is set.
First field so clients can find delegations by delegate with a memcmp at
offset 8.

fields.name: subject
docs: SPL vote account (validator) or voting wallet (staker) whose governance
authority is delegated.

fields.name: delegationAccepted
docs: Set by `accept_vote_delegation`. Until then the subject's own key keeps
voting and the delegate has no authority.

fields.name: delegateSigner
docs: The accepted vote delegate that signed the current state of this
override, or `None` when `delegator` signed it itself. Always `None` on
overrides recorded before vote delegation existed.

instructions.name: acceptAdmin
docs: Step 2 of the two-step admin transfer: the nominated admin accepts and becomes
the active admin.

instructions.name: acceptVoteDelegation
docs: Step 2 of vote delegation: the named delegate accepts. From then on the
delegate alone acts for the subject (creating, supporting, voting and
modifying for a vote account; overriding for a wallet's stake), and the
subject's own key is locked out until the delegation is removed.

accounts.name: splVoteAccount
docs: enforced here. The signer-to-vote-account binding is proved in the handler
via the meta merkle proof (vote_account == spl_vote_account, anchored to
proposal.consensus_result) plus the authority check: signer is the leaf's
voting_wallet, or the accepted delegate in `vote_delegation`.

accounts.name: voteDelegation
docs: accepted delegation on record only the delegate may sign, otherwise only
the vote account's identity may.

accounts.name: splVoteAccount
docs: enforced here. The signer here is the delegator (not the validator); the
handler proves stake_merkle_leaf.voting_wallet == signer and binds the
stake leaf to this vote account via the two-tier merkle proof
(stake_merkle_root nested inside meta_merkle_leaf).

accounts.name: voteDelegation
docs: exist. With an accepted delegation on record only the delegate may sign,
otherwise only the voting wallet may.

accounts.name: splVoteAccount
docs: enforced here; the handler then reads node_pubkey and requires the signer
to be it (or its accepted delegate), proving the signer operates this
vote account.

accounts.name: voteDelegation
docs: accepted delegation on record only the delegate may sign, otherwise only
the vote account's node identity may.

instructions.name: delegateVote
docs: Step 1 of vote delegation: names `delegate` as the key that will vote for
the subject, an SPL vote account (signed by its node identity or authorized
withdrawer) or a voting wallet (signed by the wallet itself). Takes effect
only once the delegate calls `accept_vote_delegation`.

accounts.name: subject
docs: handler decides which by owner and size, reads the vote account's
authorities in the former case, and requires the wallet itself to sign in
the latter.

accounts.name: splVoteAccount
docs: to the proposal by the init_ballot_box CPI's PDA seed check, which re-derives
[b"proposal", proposal_seed, spl_vote_account] against the signing proposal
PDA. A mismatched vote account is therefore rejected regardless of who signs
this instruction (the signer is the admin, not necessarily the author).

instructions.name: migrateVoteRecords
docs: Grows `Vote` and `VoteOverride` accounts recorded before `delegate_signer`
existed to the current layout, with the field reading `None`. Permissionless:
the signer pays the added rent. Pass the accounts to migrate as remaining
accounts; any already at the current size are skipped, so a batch may be
retried.

docs: enforced here. The signer-to-vote-account binding is proved in the handler
via the meta merkle proof (vote_account == spl_vote_account, anchored to
proposal.consensus_result) plus the authority check: signer is the leaf's
voting_wallet, or the accepted delegate in `vote_delegation`.

docs: accepted delegation on record only the delegate may sign, otherwise only
the vote account's identity may.

accounts.name: splVoteAccount
docs: enforced here. The signer here is the delegator (not the validator); the
handler proves stake_merkle_leaf.voting_wallet == signer and binds the
stake leaf to this vote account via the two-tier merkle proof
(stake_merkle_root nested inside meta_merkle_leaf).

accounts.name: voteDelegation
docs: exist. With an accepted delegation on record only the delegate may sign,
otherwise only the voting wallet may.

instructions.name: nominateAdmin
docs: Step 1 of the two-step admin transfer: the current admin nominates a new admin.
The transfer only completes once the nominee calls `accept_admin`.

instructions.name: removeVoteDelegation
docs: Removes a vote delegation and returns its rent to the subject's root
authority. The delegate may always remove. For a vote account the
authorized withdrawer may always remove, the node identity only while the
delegation is not yet accepted, and the rent goes to the withdrawer; for a
wallet the wallet itself may always remove and receives the rent.

accounts.name: subject
docs: for; the handler reads a live vote account's authorities to decide who
may remove and who receives the rent.

accounts.name: rentRecipient
docs: the subject's authorized withdrawer for a live vote account, or the
subject itself otherwise.

instructions.name: retallySupport
docs: Permissionless re-tally of a proposal's support at the current epoch.
Activates voting if the re-measured support now meets the threshold.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Any caller. Pays only the tx fee — plus the ballot-box rent iff this
retally activates voting and the ballot box does not exist yet.

accounts.name: splVoteAccount
docs: enforced here; the handler then reads node_pubkey and requires the signer
to be it (or its accepted delegate), so a supporter can only pledge stake
from a vote account they operate.

accounts.name: voteDelegation
docs: accepted delegation on record only the delegate may sign, otherwise only
the vote account's node identity may.

accounts.name: voteDelegation
docs: With an accepted delegation on record only the delegate may update the
proposal, otherwise only its author (the vote account's identity) may.
